name: shell-tools
//: The shell toolchain every shell project runs: shell.sh (shfmt and shellcheck behind the justfile pins, as each such project's format and lint targets call them, and the one discovery of the tree's shell scripts) and install-shell-tools.sh (the pinned releases, digest-checked against shell-tools.sha256, which `just bootstrap` and `just shell-tools` run), with their journeys. It depends on nothing: the projects that call it carry its script as a cached input (shellTools, shellCoverage) rather than an edge, as they do tools/coverage/coverage.sh, because several of them (bench, live) may depend on no tooling project.

options.command: bash tools/coverage/shcov.sh run shell-tools -- bun test tools/shell/tests

test.//: Offline: shell.sh over scratch scripts with the real pinned shfmt and shellcheck (a finding fails, a clean file passes, a tool off its pin is refused), and the installer against a stand-in release tree over file:// (the build for each host, digest refusal, idempotence).
